}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *[https://www.pr.com/press-release/240560 ''SMC SMCD3GNB 8x4 Residential Cable Gateway'' (PR)] :DOCSIS 3.0 8x4 (343Mbps DS/143Mbps US) <!-- The SMCD3GNB received Certifications from CableLabs Certification Wave 74. The SMCD3GNB is a market leading residential wideband gateway based on Broadcom 8x4 technology that delivers maximum wideband Internet services to residential customers. The gateway operates on up to 8 downstream and 4 upstream bonded channels supporting speeds of up to 343Mbps downstream and 143Mbps upstream. - June 10, 2010
It can probably be safely assumed that this device uses an all-'''Broadcom''' chipset. {{See also|Motorola SURFboard SBG6580|Netgear CG3000D}}
